title: Implement authenticated outbox upload and offline reconciliation worker
acceptance_criteria: Worker starts only with trusted Supabase authentication and active organization/branch membership.
Every batch is strictly scoped and server authorization/RLS revalidates scope.
Stable idempotency keys prevent duplicate logical orders, Kitchen tickets, payments or inventory movements after retries.
Parent-order and dependent event replay ordering is deterministic.
Events are marked delivered only after server-confirmed durable commit.
Retry/backoff, rate limits, expired leases, termination, offline/reconnect, duplicate replies and partial batch failure are tested.
Permanent validation/authorization conflicts are quarantined for explicit repair, never endlessly retried.
Pull sync uses organization/branch cursors and reports unresolved conflicts without blindly replaying financial operations.
Flutter, Android build, secret scanning, local migrations and pgTAP gates pass.
verification_plan: Test outbox lease scope, expiry, concurrent claims, idempotent upload and server-authorized acknowledgment.
Run offline/reconnect and application-restart integration tests against disposable Supabase.
Run duplicate/reordered event and cross-branch negative tests.
Reconcile order, payment and inventory source-of-truth totals after replay.
Run all Flutter and Supabase CI gates.
evidence: Added SyncOutboxRepository local primitives for branch-scoped leases, expired-lease recovery, bounded retry backoff, safe failure codes, delivered state and conflict quarantine.
Added seven outbox lifecycle tests for branch scope, retries, lease recovery, delivered/conflict transitions, invalid limits, concurrency and wrong-branch acknowledgment.
The repository is deliberately local-only; no authenticated network worker or cloud reconciliation has been implemented.

Draft feature-branch change adds explicit SQLite outbox dependencies: kitchen-ticket creation waits for the parent order event, and subsequent Kitchen transitions chain behind the prior ticket event. A regression test asserts dependents are not leased until the parent is marked delivered. Not locally executed; GitHub Actions runner blocker remains open.

Follow-up hardening adds a v1→v2 backfill plan for legacy outbox dependencies: map Kitchen creation events to parent order creation events, chain subsequent ticket transitions, and quarantine unresolved events. Adds migration regression coverage plus a cross-branch dependency negative test. Not locally executed; CI runner outage remains open.

Added a draft Supabase RPC and pgTAP suite for stable Kitchen-transition event receipts, expected-from-state compare-and-set, same-event replay, role/branch checks, and audit de-duplication. Added docs/p2-sync-contract.md documenting the worker contract, cloud catalog prerequisite, and why ticket creation is acknowledged only after the order RPC creates it. SQL/tests are not executed; CI runners remain unavailable.

Reviewed current Supabase function-security guidance while preparing the RPC. The new public SECURITY DEFINER endpoint is intentionally authenticated-only and guarded by role/scope/status checks, but remains subject to independent advisor/security review; no suppression or production deployment is authorized.

Drafted AuthenticatedOutboxSyncWorker with session/branch gating, bounded sequential batches, save_order upload using the raw UUID suffix for idempotency, verification of the server-created Kitchen ticket (no duplicate insert), and apply_kitchen_transition_event replay. Added six SQLite FFI tests for auth/branch denial, end-to-end parent→ticket→transition order, server conflict quarantine, retry/backoff, and malformed payloads. Tests not run.

Code review changed Kitchen-create acknowledgment to replay the original save_order RPC with the same key and exact payload after the parent event is done, requiring already_saved=true and the same ticket ID. This avoids a direct kitchen_tickets SELECT permission dependency and cannot insert a duplicate ticket.

Static review found Counter-only actors cannot call the Kitchen transition RPC. Added a required per-event permission callback and role_not_permitted retry code so valid Kitchen events are deferred rather than permanently quarantined when the active actor lacks that role; added a worker regression test. Not executed.

Added AuthRepository.canPerformSyncEvent and a pure role matrix for order creation, Kitchen-ticket replay, and Kitchen transitions. Six permission tests cover owner, manager, counter, kitchen, missing branch role and unsupported events. Worker integration must pass this callback and keep server-side RPC checks enabled. Auth tests are authored but unrun.
blocker: P2 worker and tests remain draft/unverified. CI jobs repeatedly fail before runner assignment; no Flutter/Dart or local Supabase toolchain available. The callback must be wired to live AuthRepository role membership before enabling the worker.
next_action: Wire AuthRepository.canPerformSyncEvent into AuthenticatedOutboxSyncWorker at the future sync orchestration boundary, then execute format/analyzer/auth+worker tests/full Flutter suite/Gitleaks/APK and fresh local Supabase migration/pgTAP after Actions runner recovery.
